description: In fMRI, a 50 ms change to mask timing switched a stimulus between reported awareness and unawareness while measured attention stayed similar. Awareness was associated with parts of the frontoparietal control and ventral attention networks overlapping the TPJ (Webb et al. 2016a, as reported by Graziano).
limitations: Reported secondhand. Attention was sampled at one time point, so equating it is approximate, the point of the Morales et al. critique.

sources.quote: The results implicated specific cortical networks including parts of the fronto-parietal control network and the ventral attention network, both of which overlap the temporoparietal junction (TPJ).
